description: Search state legislative bills across all covered US jurisdictions. Supports full-text search, jurisdiction/session filtering, subject tags, sponsor lookups, and sort order. Either jurisdiction or q (full-text) is required, and pairing them is the reliable form — a q-only search spans all 56 jurisdictions and exceeds the upstream timeout for a common term, though a distinctive one still returns quickly. include=sponsorships,actions returns sponsor and action history inline. sort=latest_action_desc surfaces bills currently moving. openstates_get_jurisdiction with include=legislative_sessions returns valid session identifiers for session filtering.

action_since.description: ISO 8601 date — only return bills with an action after this date (e.g., "2025-01-01").

chamber.description: Filter by originating chamber. "upper" = Senate, "lower" = House/Assembly.

created_since.description: ISO 8601 date — only return bills first entered in Open States after this date (e.g., "2025-01-01"). Use to find newly-introduced bills, as opposed to recently-updated or recently-acted-on.

include.description: Related data to inline. "sponsorships" and "actions" cover most research needs without a separate openstates_get_bill call. "votes" adds full vote tallies and per-legislator positions.

jurisdiction.description: State name, two-letter abbreviation, or OCD-ID (e.g., "Washington", "wa", or "ocd-jurisdiction/country:us/state:wa/government"). Required unless q is provided.

q.description: Full-text search across bill titles, abstracts, and text. Required unless jurisdiction is provided. Pair it with jurisdiction whenever a state is known — a q-only search over every jurisdiction times out upstream for a common term.

session.description: Session identifier (e.g., "2025", "2025-2026", "2025rs"). Use openstates_get_jurisdiction with include=legislative_sessions to discover valid values. Omit to search across all sessions.

sort.description: Sort order. Use "latest_action_desc" for bills currently moving through the legislature.

sponsor.description: Filter by sponsor name or OCD person ID.

subject.description: Filter to bills tagged with one or more subject categories.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date — only return bills updated after this date (e.g., "2025-01-01").

name: openstates_search_bills

appliedFilters.description: Filters applied to this query as the server received them, for agent self-verification of zero or unexpected results.

subject.description: Subject tags filtered on, as received. Absent when none were supplied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout — the query is too broad. `invalid_page`: Open States rejected the request as not found — page is past the last page for this query. `rate_limited`: The shared Open States API key reached a request cap — Open States' per-minute or daily limit, or this server's own daily budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — names every filter that narrowed the query and suggests how to broaden. Absent when results are returned.

abstracts.description: Bill abstracts when include=abstracts is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

actions.description: Action history when include=actions is requested.

date.description: Action date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date.

organization.description: Chamber or committee where action occurred.

documents.description: Bill documents (fiscal notes, etc.) when include=documents is requested.

date.description: Document date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date, which is the usual case for bill documents.

note.description: Document note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

id.description: OCD bill ID — use as openstates_id in openstates_get_bill.

identifier.description: Bill identifier as used by the legislature (e.g., "HB 1000").

openstates_url.description: Citable Open States page for this bill.

other_identifiers.description: Alternate identifiers when include=other_identifiers is requested.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme (the issuing system). Absent for bills — Open States omits it on every bill record observed.

other_titles.description: Alternate titles when include=other_titles is requested.

note.description: Note describing the alternate title. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

related_bills.description: Related bills when include=related_bills is requested.

sources.description: Source documents when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

person.description: Linked person record when the sponsor resolves to a known legislator.

id.description: OCD person ID — an exact handle where the sponsor name string is often only a family name. Pass it to openstates_search_people as id for the full legislator record, or back as the sponsor filter to find this legislator's other bills.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary sponsor.

subject.description: Subject tags assigned by Open States scrapers.

updated_at.description: Timestamp Open States last updated this record — the field the default sort=updated_desc orders by.

versions.description: Bill text versions when include=versions is requested.

date.description: Version date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date, which is the usual case for bill versions.

note.description: Version note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

votes.description: Vote events when include=votes is requested.

value.description: Count of votes for this option.

start_date.description: Vote date. Empty string when Open States recorded no date.

totalCount.description: Total bills matching the query across all pages.

title: Search Bills
